The full test suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 2/2 tests passing, including the new postcode-precedence tests).

## Summary

The locality derivation now prefers the postcode over the city-to-region table.

**`Locality.java`** — added a small, cohesive `of(String city, String postcode)` overload plus a private `byPostcode` helper. It looks up the region by postcode range first (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falls back to the existing `of(city)` table only when the postcode is absent or in no known range. The original `of(String)` is untouched, so `ValidatePostcode` (which uses city-based ranges for validation) is unaffected.

**`OwnerMapper.java`** — changed the one `locality` mapping expression to pass `owner.getPostcode()` alongside the city.

Structural impact was kept low: two files touched, all new logic lives in the tiny `Locality` class (near-zero surrounding complexity), and the mapper change is a single-line expression edit. Known cities still resolve to the same region, while same-named cities are now disambiguated by postcode.
